name: application-data-quality-score
title: Data Quality Score
description: Circular pass/fail check summary ring with a failing-rule list, distinct from application-lead-score-meter since it summarizes validation checks on a dataset rather than a lead's fit or intent score.
useWhen: Summarizing how many validation checks a dataset or import passed versus failed as a single score.
Listing the specific failing rules so a user knows what to fix.
Surfacing a dataset's quality status inline in a list of files or tables via a compact summary bar.
avoidWhen: The score represents a lead's fit or purchase intent rather than data validation — use application-lead-score-meter instead.
No specific failing rules can be listed — a plain pass/fail badge is more honest than an empty or vague list.
The dataset has only one validation rule — a single pass/fail indicator is simpler than a full score ring.
responsiveBehavior: Both variants have a fixed max width; Variant 1's failing-rule list wraps naturally within the card, and Variant 2's dataset name and check counts wrap onto a second line on narrow screens.
accessibility: The score ring carries role='img' with an aria-label stating the numeric score in words, since the ring visual alone doesn't convey the exact number to assistive technology.
Failing rules are listed as real text with row counts, not just an icon, so screen readers get the full context.
The 'needs attention' framing in Variant 2 is real text, not conveyed by the amber color alone.

variants.title: Score ring with failing rules
variants.description: Circular score ring paired with a list of specific failing validation rules and their failure counts.
accessibility: The ring's aria-label states the exact score in words, not just a visual fill percentage.

variants.title: Score ring with failing rules (Dark)
variants.description: Score ring with a failing-rule list, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Ring fill and failing-rule text contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Compact summary bar
variants.description: Horizontal summary bar with a smaller score ring, pass/fail/total counts, and a View report action — for inline use in a file or table list.
accessibility: The 'needs attention' message is real text, not conveyed by the amber background alone.

variants.title: Compact summary bar (Dark)
variants.description: Compact data-quality summary bar adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Amber tint and text contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
